annotations.title: Inspect USD, India and country funding metrics

description: Inspect a funding desk's rates, spreads, policy corridor, liquidity buffers and source-level evidence. Choose this for detailed funding metrics; use world_markets_context for a cross-asset overview, or market_workbench for FX and accepted China time series. Start with section='summary' for USD; it also returns funding_pop, a separate research-only block with its skill, as the website shows it. Use section='countries' for the public-source country catalog, or add country='JP' (a supported ISO alpha-2 code; UK is an alias for GB) for dated policy, funding, liquidity and sovereign references. Country coverage is partial and monthly references are explicitly separate from daily curves. Granular, descriptive USD money-market context from the already assembled desk: policy corridor and overnight spreads; SOFR/TGCR/BGCR distributions and tails; repo-segment rates and volumes; CP-Treasury spreads; bills and cash curve; liquidity buffers and Fed facilities; and MMF repo plumbing. Use section='rates_catalog', 'funding_conditions', 'curve', 'spread' or 'rate_series' for the official rates research desk: stored series with source clocks; overnight benchmarks against policy anchor and corridor across currencies; government curves with slopes and exact forwards where the convention allows; spread percentiles in their own history with the window stated. Use section='india_states' for RBI's weekly state government securities (SDL) auctions by state (latest auction, 52-week issuance, cut-offs and bid cover). Use section='india' for the India funding, RBI liquidity, policy and sovereign-curve desk from a bounded canonical observation read. It keeps benchmark identities, date alignment, curve movements and mechanism hypotheses separate. India defaults to view='full' for compatibility; prefer view='summary' for findings, constraints and an exact metric ID catalog, then view='metric' with metric_id for one complete evidence card. These India-only views are independent reads, not a pinned snapshot or pagination. Otherwise use optional `section` to request a compact summary, one named USD desk section, diagnostics, sources, methodology, or all context. Diagnostics count funding persistence, compare secured/unsecured benchmarks and show calendar cohorts with sample limits, without changing any score. Returns exact-date alignment, native-cadence changes, empirical own-history statistics, freshness, coverage, formulas, sources, and caveats as applicable. Chart history is always omitted. USD reads only an already completed cached or persisted snapshot; it never triggers collection or engine recomputation, while freshness is re-evaluated at response time. Context only: no causal, predictive, probability, or trade claim.

compare.description: curve only: comparison ISO date, same rule as date.

country.description: Country code for section=countries only. Omit to list supported countries; UK aliases GB.

curve.description: curve only: curve id, for example EA_AAA_SPOT. Omit to list curves.

date.description: curve only: ISO date; the latest curve date on or before it is used.

instrument.description: rate_series only: instrument id from section=rates_catalog.

markets.description: funding_conditions only: comma list of market ids, for example US-USD,EA-EUR.

metric_id.description: Exact ID from the India summary metric_catalog; required only for view=metric.

section.description: Projection to return; defaults to the compact desk summary.

spread.description: spread only: spread id, for example EA_AAA_2S10S. Omit to list spreads.

view.description: India only: legacy full desk, compact findings/catalog, or one exact metric card.

window_days.description: funding_conditions and spread only: own-history window in days for percentiles.

name: money_market_context

outputSchema.description: Chartless USD, India and country funding envelopes for supported selectors.

india.description: Legacy full India desk, or opt-in summary with metric_catalog and freshness_summary, or exact metric with selection_status and selection_context. Missing/restricted cards retain their original status.
